### Summary
Describe the feature or workflow improvement you'd like to see in Velox WM.

### Problem / Use Case
What friction does this solve or what desktop/gaming/battery workflow does it enable?

### Proposed Behavior
Explain how users should configure or trigger it (compositor UI, `velox-settings`, config key, shortcut).
